topics.titleTr: Dayanıklı Yürütme ve Temporal'a Ne Zaman Gerek?

topics.angle: deep-dive|What durable execution solves and when a workflow engine like Temporal earns its weight.
topics.brief: Sections: the failure mode (long-running multi-step processes that must survive crashes, retries and restarts); how durable execution persists progress as code; where it beats cron+queues+outbox; costs (operational weight, learning curve, determinism rules); lighter alternatives for simple cases. Verify: durable-execution/determinism constraints; Temporal vs DBMQ/outbox tradeoffs in 2026. Sources: Temporal docs; durable-execution writeups. Distinct from 'Transactional Outbox', 'Event-Driven Architecture', 'Retries/Backoff': focused on durable execution as a model.

topics.angle: how-to|Catch breaking API changes before deploy with consumer-driven contract tests.

Verify: tail-based sampling and cardinality cost drivers in 2026; OTel Collector processors. Sources: OpenTelemetry docs; observability-cost writeups. Distinct from 'Observability 101' and 'FinOps': focused on cutting telemetry cost.

A consumer checklist distinct from the production 'reduce hallucinations' engineering post.
